create_LanguageModelInference: create a LanguageModelInference instance with a vocab path and model checkpoint load directory
run_beam_decode: run beam search decoding on an input string using the LanguageModelInference beam_decode method
encode_decode_tokens: encode a string to token IDs or decode token IDs back to text using the vocab
call_model_inference: call the Meliad model directly with padded input arrays and optional decoder state
parse_gin_configuration: parse a GIN configuration file using the inference_utils parse_gin_configuration function
